paragraphs.text: The Pontotoc City Choir will present its Patriotic Concert at 6 p.m. Thursday, November 5, in the Pontotoc Junior High School auditorium, according to a school announcement.

A separate event supporting the choir follows Saturday, November 14. Pontotoc City Choir and EPW Wrestling are hosting Warrior Rumble at the Pontotoc County Agri-Center, with the wrestling show scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. EPW says proceeds will benefit the Pontotoc City Choir program.

For the November 14 wrestling fundraiser, EPW lists doors opening at 6 p.m. General admission is $10, student general admission is $5, and Golden Circle seating in the first two rows is $15. Those ticket prices apply to Warrior Rumble.

The Agri-Center is at 430 CJ Hardin Jr. Drive in Pontotoc. The organizer’s event page includes ticket information and notes that the wrestling card is subject to change. The school’s original notice and the organizer’s details are linked below.
